visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a white shopping bag featuring an illustration of two girls in pink dresses against a brightly lit retail store background. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a book-like box with an illustration of a girl drinking tea, followed by a blue box being placed inside the shopping bag. (3) A sequence of close-ups follows, showing stacks of white 'Number Sugar' boxes, individual candy wrappers with numbers, and a silver dish containing a single wrapper. (4) The video transitions to a different store showcasing 'N.Y.C. SAND' packaging, including black and gold boxes and gold-wrapped biscuits displayed on a plate. (5) Another cut reveals 'Crème Brûlée Tart' boxes and a plate of small tarts with caramelized tops, followed by a display of honey toast-shaped biscuits. (6) A hand lifts a 'Tartine' shopping bag with two girls, then shows deer-shaped crackers in clear plastic packaging. (7) Flower-shaped 'Sabrina' pastries are shown on a platter, followed by stacks of blue and white boxes. (8) Large 'Nenrinya' baumkuchen cakes are displayed, both whole and sliced, on a clean retail counter. (9) A pink heart-shaped 'TOKYO TULIP ROSE' box is opened to reveal tulip-shaped cookies in various colors. (10) The video ends with a pink information screen featuring social media icons and the 'Japanuts' brand logo.
